summary: Round 1's blocker is resolved and independently verified: with librados2/librbd1 installed, the published pvginkel/homelab provider executes on ubuntu:noble and reaches its own plugin guard instead of dying at the dynamic loader, and my own kaniko build of HEAD is green including the new CDLL assertion. The fix is complete for this provider — go-ceph rados/rbd is its whole native surface and no other declared provider is cgo. One Minor advisory finding, in the phase record rather than the code.

findings.summary: plan.md:572-574 claims the build assertion was mutation-confirmed to fail when either package is dropped, but librbd1 depends on librados2 on noble, so dropping librados2 alone leaves the build green.
